title: The 1913 shootout and shutdown of cabarets
summary: A Tuxedo shootout led police to close district cabarets, starting the musicians' exodus in 1913.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene
